title: ObservabilityConfig
description: ObservabilityConfig holds the observability configuration for an entry point.

accessLogs.description: AccessLogs enables access logs for this router.

metrics.description: Metrics enables metrics for this router.

traceVerbosity.description: TraceVerbosity defines the verbosity level of the tracing for this router.

tracing.description: Tracing enables tracing for this router.
